evidence.note: Inspected workspace, data shard sizes, tokenizer, GPU, and template; established vocab size (8192) and token dtype from actual data rather than assuming defaults.
Identified duplicate tied embedding/lm_head weights wasting checkpoint space and patched save/load to reconstruct — shows deep grasp of int8 dequant round-trip within the byte budget.
Empirically tested 17/18-layer checkpoint compressed sizes against the 32,000,000-byte decimal cap up front, deriving the size↔capacity envelope before full training.
Verified the checkpoint loads via load_model_for_verification, returns logits (B,T,8192), and forward loss exactly equals cross_entropy — confirming both forward signatures and contract compliance.
Final orientation-driven verification of size (30,889,172 < 32,000,000), load path, and loss contract before submitting.

reasoning: The agent deliberately mapped the loading/forward contract against real artifacts: it probed data/tokenizer to confirm vocab and format, chose and implemented the load_model_for_verification path, understood int8 dequant round-trip (patching tied-weight duplication), and verified both forward signatures and position-dependent logits equalling cross_entropy — matching the level-8 anchor. It also derived the size↔capacity↔quantization envelope up front via checkpoint-size tests and correctly treated the 32MB cap as decimal, edging toward level 10, but it implemented only one load path and never reasoned about bf16-noise stability or the args/model tuple form, so it stops short of full 10.
